core_laws: No omission without an authoritative determinant, exact scope, counterexample path, reconstruction law, and fail-closed violation behavior.
Observed constancy or frequency never creates a functional dependency.
Physical missing state remains event-grain in the R02 proposal.
Float identity is decoder-observed IEEE bits, not textual repr/parse.
Integer width derives from native type/cardinality metadata, never sampled range.
Strings preserve exact decoder-observed Unicode sequence including empty string and embedded NUL; no normalization.
Date/time conversion requires exact native type authority; otherwise preserve native numeric/string payload plus source format metadata.
Value-label dictionaries are release-variable-local; selected labels are derivable only by exact typed-key lookup.
Rectangular logical locator is release-scoped L=r*V+v under a sealed complete traversal law; Parquet row position is never canonical.
Hot/cold separation remains one sealed canonical release and never creates an optional provenance tier.
